description: Live-gateway shape: the gateway federates tools as "<server-prefix>-<op>" and slugifies underscores to hyphens, so the tool arrives as "ucp-shop-complete-checkout" — no underscore survives. This fixture proves the policy still matches (an underscore-only suffix match would fail open here). Scenario otherwise identical to deny.json: complete_checkout whose checkout.line_items (canonical args.checkout shape) contain a DTwo-supplied restricted SKU (input.context.restricted_skus). Policy should deny and name the restricted item id. Tool name is read from input.resource.name (suffix-matched), never input.payload.name.

expected.reasonContains: Item 'SKU-RESTRICTED-001' is in a restricted category
